title: Concept: .NET stack trace in a response
description: A .NET exception type with its namespace in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The trace names the framework version, the assembly and often the connection string's origin, which narrows the attack to a specific build and deployment.
applicability: ASP.NET Core applications with the developer exception page reachable in production.
risk: Framework and assembly detail shortens the path from probing to a targeted exploit.
